title: REQ · Claude adapter passes restricted-permission flags to the CLI
summary: Claude CLI is invoked with a permission mode and allow/deny tool lists that exclude shell and network
description: Context: Claude.Run currently calls Exec with only `-p` and the prompt. Desired behavior: also pass `--permission-mode acceptEdits`, `--allowedTools Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep` and `--disallowedTools Bash,WebFetch,WebSearch`. Expected result: the agent can edit workspace files but not run shell commands or reach the network. Why: restricted permissions are mandated for coding agents.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fake Exec, when Run is called, then args contain --permission-mode followed by acceptEdits
Given a fake Exec, when Run is called, then --disallowedTools lists Bash and --allowedTools does not list Bash
technical_constraints: Args are a []string, never a joined command string
